notes: Dobility's SurveyCTO developer portal (developer.surveycto.com) is a VitePress site whose per-endpoint reference pages are rendered client-side from two vendor-published OpenAPI 3.0.1 documents at /specs/api-v1.json and /specs/api-v2.json (found by noticing the sidebar's exact method+title listing smelled like a generated-from-spec doc site, then guessing the conventional /specs/<page>.json path off the page's own slug -- confirmed live, not a lead). Previously this adaptor's spec was hand-authored, docs-only, and explicitly scoped to "the endpoints the adaptor actually calls" (9 ops); reading the adaptor's compiled source shows it has a real generic builder (http.get/post/request/_delete, reaching any relative path), so per AGENTS.md that narrow scope was the disallowed anti-pattern, not a legitimate design choice. api-v2.json (43 ops / 60 schemas, the current API: datasets, dataset records, form submissions, users, roles, teams, groups, workflow profiles) is committed verbatim as upstream.json. api-v1.json (6 ops, legacy form-export endpoints: long/wide/per-repeat-group CSV, file URL listing, CSV linebreak settings -- none of which api-v2 exposes) is committed verbatim as upstream-v1.json (sha256:9a608f5b8c85a3b893603f41ab5839eb6c9def40a05d2f9a7dbade087ce23cef); its 6 exclusive paths are merged into the served openapi.json alongside v2's 25, and its schemas are a strict subset of v2's under identical names (verified field-for-field equal before merging, so no renaming was needed). Both versions are genuinely reachable: the adaptor's buildUrl reads apiVersion from the credential (default 'v1') and inserts it into every request path, so which document applies depends on how a given credential is configured, not on anything the adaptor hardcodes. Verified against ast.json/adaptor source: fetchSubmissions builds forms/data/(wide/<format>|csv)/<formId>, matching both the v1 and v2 forms endpoints; list/upsertDataset/upsertRecord/uploadCsvRecords build /datasets(...) paths that only exist in v2. Server URL is the vendor's own placeholder (https://your-server.surveycto.com); the adaptor's real host is servername.surveycto.com, servername coming from the credential. Known imprecision in the upstream document, found via openfn-mocker conformance testing: v1's wide-JSON download (formJsonWideDataHandlerV1) types its response as a bare string, while v2's equivalent operation (formJsonHandlerV2) documents the same conceptual export as "the submissions as a JSON array in wide format" (type: array) -- the vendor's own v1 doc-generation was simply less precise than v2's for this response. The mock returns a real array (matching v2's explicit description and how wide-JSON exports are actually consumed), not a JSON-encoded string, and test:conformance flags that one divergence against v1's literal (mis-)typed schema; left as-is per the verbatim-upstream rule rather than edited away.

upstream.note: Primary/current document. api-v1.json (the legacy addendum) is committed separately as upstream-v1.json; see notes for its hash.
